description: Type annotations and interface definitions for torch._C._functorch, including functions, classes, and enums related to tensor transformations, autodiff, and dynamic layers in PyTorch's functorch module.

classes.name: TransformType
classes.description: Enum representing different transformation types in functorch (Torch, Vmap, Grad, Jvp, Functionalize).

classes.name: RandomnessType
classes.description: Enum representing types of randomness in vmap (Error, Same, Different).

classes.name: CInterpreter
classes.description: Interface for a C++ interpreter object with methods to get its key, level, serialize, and deserialize.

classes.name: CGradInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer wrapper for a CInterpreter, with methods to lift tensors and check previous grad mode.

classes.name: CJvpInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer wrapper for a CInterpreter, with methods to lift tensors and check previous forward gradient mode.

classes.name: CFunctionalizeInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer wrapper for a CInterpreter, with methods related to functionalization and back views.

classes.name: CVmapInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer wrapper for a CInterpreter, with methods for batch size, randomness, and key/level info.

methods.name: set_inplace_requires_grad_allowed
methods.description: Sets whether in-place requires grad is allowed.

methods.name: get_inplace_requires_grad_allowed
methods.description: Gets whether in-place requires grad is allowed.

methods.name: _set_dynamic_layer_keys_included
methods.description: Sets whether dynamic layer keys are included.

methods.name: get_unwrapped
methods.description: Returns the unwrapped version of a tensor.

methods.name: is_batchedtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a batched tensor.

methods.name: is_functionaltensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a functional tensor.

methods.name: is_functorch_wrapped_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is wrapped by functorch.

methods.name: is_gradtrackingtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor tracks gradients.

methods.name: is_legacy_batchedtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a legacy batched tensor.

methods.name: unwrap_if_dead
methods.description: Unwraps tensor if it is dead.

methods.name: set_single_level_autograd_function_allowed
methods.description: Sets whether single level autograd functions are allowed.

methods.name: get_single_level_autograd_function_allowed
methods.description: Checks if single level autograd functions are allowed.
